newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES LITTLE CHANGED.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES LITTLE CHANGED.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed little changed in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 599.88 from 599.14 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 1.26 million dinars against 1.53 million dinars.
Amen Bank won 1.68 dinar to 57.78 dinars. BNA bank was up 0.93 dinar to 31.95 dinars. Airliner Tunis Air gained 0.56 dinar to 19.25 dinars.
BETI bank was down 1.71 dinar to 27.78 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
